verdict.rationale: The docs show the API can return events: up to 200 per page with cursor pagination and sparse fieldsets. Events track a profile's activity, and Klaviyo says its data can be pulled and read headlessly through public APIs. Together this points to readable activity history, but nothing explicitly shows filtering events to one contact or exposing sent/opened/clicked engagement records. Missing for 10: an explicit per-profile event/timeline query, documentation of email engagement metrics (received, opened, clicked) being retrievable, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
